rows.grounds: compound of pāda, pāṃśu, and samāyukta describing materials joined with dust from the feet
indeclinable indicating interior placement or inclusion
compound of ghṛta and gomaya denoting the substances used together

items.question: Which materials combined within are prescribed for the stated ritual preparation?
premises: The preparation includes substances combined with foot-dust.
Ghee and cow-dung are specified as materials.
These materials are to be used within.
items.inference: The prescribed preparation consists of ghee and cow-dung combined with foot-dust used within.
uncertainties: The exact referent of antarā in the ritual procedure is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Within, use ghee and cow-dung combined with foot-dust.
